# brain-drain: bill of materials

Quantities are per board; the unit has one brain board and four to eight bay cards. Machine-readable copies: `hardware/bom/brain-drain-bom.csv` and `hardware/bom/bay-card-bom.csv` (both regenerated by `python3 hardware/tools/gen_bom.py`).
Vendors and prices are budgeting figures from 2026 (LCSC, Digi-Key, Mouser), not quotes.
